full_prompt_en: A wide fantasy landscape looks across a snow-covered mountain ridge at twilight. A tiny dark traveler stands on the sloping foreground at lower right, giving scale to the immense terrain. Jagged blue-grey peaks rise at left, then descend into a broad misty basin where pale channels curve toward the horizon. Far in the middle distance, a slender tower or spire climbs straight up through the pink haze. An enormous dusky moon hangs above it to the upper right, its lower edge dimly lit and its surface textured with muted rose and blue. Thin cloud streaks sweep diagonally across the sky, glowing peach near the low horizon and turning cool slate farther overhead. The image has the smooth, carefully blended surface of digital landscape painting, with sharper rocky edges in the foreground and softer forms in the far valley. Warm sunset light lies low behind the spire, while cool blue shadow fills the snow and mountains. The ridge enters from the lower right and leads toward the tower, balancing the distant vertical point against the round moon. Broad gradients of sky and snow make a spacious pause around these two small, precise anchors.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅宽阔奇幻风景从暮色中的积雪山脊望向远方。右下斜坡上站着一个很小的深色旅人，为巨大的地形提供尺度。左边蓝灰色锯齿山峰升起，随后降入宽阔雾霭谷地，浅色蜿蜒线条朝地平线延伸。远方中景，一座细长的塔尖从粉色薄雾里直直升起。巨大的昏暗月球悬在其右上方，下缘带微光，表面有低饱和玫瑰色和蓝色纹理。薄云斜扫天空，靠近低地平线处呈桃色，越向上越转为冷石板色。画面有数字风景绘画平滑而细致融合的表面，近处岩石边缘较锐，远谷形体更柔。暖色落日光停在塔后低处，冷蓝阴影填满雪地和山峦。山脊从右下进入并引向尖塔，远方竖点与圆形月球相平衡。天空与雪地的宽阔渐变在这两个精确锚点周围留下辽阔停顿。
style_prompt_en: A smooth digital landscape painting uses broad atmospheric gradients and carefully tiered detail. Cool blue and slate shadow cover the lower planes, while peach and mauve light gathers in a narrow horizontal band near the horizon. A large translucent circular form floats in the upper field, balanced by a very thin vertical mark in the distance. Foreground edges and dark rock accents remain comparatively crisp; farther ridges, winding pale bands, and clouds soften progressively into haze. Low backlight separates layered silhouettes without harsh front illumination. A long diagonal slope directs the eye inward across a wide basin, then upward through the slender distant accent. The composition alternates immense quiet color fields with a few precise details, giving the scene an expansive and slow visual rhythm.
style_prompt_zh: 平滑的数字风景绘画使用大面积空气渐变和分层控制的细节。冷蓝与石板色阴影覆盖下方平面，桃色与淡紫光聚成贴近地平线的窄横带。上方大块区域里悬浮一个半透明圆形，与远处极细竖线平衡。前景边缘与深色岩面点缀相对清楚；远山、蜿蜒浅色带和云层逐步软化为薄雾。低位逆光分开连续剪影，没有强烈正面照明。一条长斜坡把目光引入宽广盆地，再沿远处细竖点上升。构图让巨大的安静色面与少数精确细节交替，使场景呈现辽阔、缓慢的视觉节奏。
theme_en: A lone traveler on a snowy ridge beneath a vast moon and distant spire
theme_zh: 巨大月球与远方尖塔下的雪脊独行者
name: Jessica Rossier
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
